sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹5L–₹20L inferred from deductible table)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses payable at actuals as per policy wording Section C1(b).

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Optional: 5%/10%/15%/20% voluntary co-pay for premium discount. If 'Cashless Discount' optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, spine, cancer, etc. in exchange for premium discount.

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible options (₹10k–₹3L) available as optional discount feature.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability credit from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers 18 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, joint surgeries, organ transplant, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered. No optional maternity add-on mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Two options: once per policy year or unlimited times per year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. Subsequent claim must be after 2-day gap from discharge (waived for different insured person).

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Indicative list of 399+ procedures provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available; must exceed 3 days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, vector-borne, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. Outpatient and comfort treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges up to In-patient SI. Covers transfer to nearest hospital and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stereotactic radiosurgery, HIFU, etc.) covered up to SI. Cumulative bonus and restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Non-medical items listed in Annexure II are excluded. Medical consumables used during treatment/surgery are covered as part of hospitalisation.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only. Any medical expenses outside India explicitly excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only, not on renewals or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment; domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma/epilepsy; no maternity; terrorism covered; no consumables rider

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Disease Sub-limits (discount), Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount
